params.name: uplo
params.reference:
On entry, `UPLO` specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the matrix A is supplied in the packed array `AP` as follows:

`UPLO = 'U'` or 'u' The upper triangular part of A is

supplied in `AP`.

`UPLO = 'L'` or 'l' The lower triangular part of A is

supplied in `AP`.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the order of the matrix A. N must be at least zero.

params.name: AP
params.reference: ( ( n\*( n + 1 ) )/2 ). Before entry with `UPLO = 'U'` or 'u', the array `AP` must contain the upper triangular part of the hermitian matrix packed sequentially, column by column, so that AP( 1 ) contains a( 1, 1 ), AP( 2 ) and AP( 3 ) contain a( 1, 2 ) and a( 2, 2 ) respectively, and so on. Before entry with `UPLO = 'L'` or 'l', the array `AP` must contain the lower triangular part of the hermitian matrix packed sequentially, column by column, so that AP( 1 ) contains a( 1, 1 ), AP( 2 ) and AP( 3 ) contain a( 2, 1 ) and a( 3, 1 ) respectively, and so on. Note that the imaginary parts of the diagonal elements need not be set and are assumed to be zero.

params.name: x
params.reference: ( 1 + ( n - 1 )\*abs( `INCX` ) ). Before entry, the incremented array X must contain the n element vector x.

params.name: incx
params.reference: On entry, `INCX` specifies the increment for the elements of X. `INCX` must not be zero.

params.name: beta
params.reference: On entry, `BETA` specifies the scalar $\beta$. When `BETA` is supplied as zero then Y need not be set on input.

params.name: y
params.reference: ( 1 + ( n - 1 )\*abs( `INCY` ) ). Before entry, the incremented array Y must contain the n element vector y. On exit, Y is overwritten by the updated vector y.

params.name: incy
params.reference: On entry, `INCY` specifies the increment for the elements of Y. `INCY` must not be zero.

quickReturn.js: N === 0 || (real( alpha ) === 0 && imag( alpha ) === 0 && (real( beta ) === 1 && imag( beta ) === 0))
